items.item_text: Required Bachelor's degree in related area and / or equivalent experience / training Bachelor's Degree
4-6 years At least 5 years of experience working within higher education or government operations is required.
4-6 years Proven expertise in drafting, analyzing, and negotiating complex travel, entertainment, lodging, and facility use agreements to minimize institutional liability.

4-6 years Strong working knowledge of labor compliance, collective bargaining agreements, and policies regarding contracting out for covered services (such as UC Regents Policy 5402 or similar state/institutional mandates).
4-6 years Demonstrated ability to review financial terms, audit vendor invoices for wage and benefit parity, and manage advanced spreadsheets for compliance reporting.
4-6 years Proficiency in managing digital contract intake queues (such as ServiceNow) and centralized compliance tracking databases (such as AgileOne).
4-6 years Excellent interpersonal and communication skills with a track record of partnering effectively with Risk Management, Legal Counsel, and Labor Relations departments.

Covered Individuals: A Covered Individual includes anyone designated as Personnel or Students under this Policy who physically access a University Facility or Program in connection with their employment, appointment, or education/training. A person accessing a Healthcare Location as a patient, or an art, athletics, entertainment, or other publicly accessible venue at a Location as a member of the public, is not a Covered Individual.
